manifest.name: dsh-session-purge
manifest.description: DeepSeek Harness maintenance plugin: permanently purge a session (disk log, projection cache, workspace accounting, temp tool outputs, subagent cascade) or redact secrets inside its zstd log in place with the frame layout preserved; plus copyable console instructions for resetting the page UI layout. Entries: Settings panel (session cleanup, grouped by workspace), sidebar row menu (official slot).

dshNotes.redact: in-place zstd redaction requires Node >= 23.8 (runtime feature-detected; without it the redact route returns 501 and everything else keeps working)

bundle.text:
# dsh-session-purge bundle layer: inserts the plugin row into a profile stack.
# Loaded when a profile lists `dsh-session-purge` in its bundles (or by hand
# through this patch). The row id stays stable so later profile patches can
# target it.
- insert:
    - id: session-purge
      name: 'dsh-session-purge'

readme.text:
[English](README.en.md) | 简体中文

> [!IMPORTANT]
> 社区第三方插件，与 DeepSeek 官方无隶属关系；触点均为 Harness 内部实现面（非文档化 API）。
> 兼容基线：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop` **0.2.1-rc.5**（Windows x64，nightly 渠道；rc.3 于 2026-10-26 逐触点审计，rc.5 于 2026-10-30 复核）。nightly 更新可能**静默破坏兼容**——升级 DSH 后先运行 `node --test test/purge.test.mjs`（应 36/36）。

> [!WARNING]
> **删除即永久，无回收站**；脱敏只改写本地日志文件，**不能替代密钥轮换**。

管理 DeepSeek Harness 会话数据的两个操作：

- **永久删除**：磁盘日志 + 投影缓存 + 工作区记账 + 工具输出临时文件，级联清除全部子代理会话；
- **原地脱敏**：把敏感值（完整值/前缀）掩码写入会话 zstd 日志，保留历史，帧结构不变。

| 入口 | 位置 |
|---|---|
| 设置 → **会话清理** | 按工作区分组的会话列表：单会话删除（行内两段确认，Enter/Esc/10 秒撤防）、脱敏对话框、「删除工作区」（组头按钮，两段确认；成员运行中整体 409 拒绝；部分失败保留工作区并逐条报告）、搜索与"仅磁盘残留"筛选 |
| 会话行"…"菜单 | 末尾「删除」项（官方槽位 `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item`），删除该行会话且不切换当前对话 |

完成对话框报告释放字节、级联数与临时清扫摘要；对话框配色全部取宿主主题 token，跟随深浅色。

```js
['dsh.sidebar-right.v1','dsh.sidebar-browser.v1','dsh.workspace.view.v5','dsh.conversation.contentWidth','dsh.trajectory.duration','dsh.trajectory.jsonStringWrapping','dsh.session-purge.reset-layout-on-boot'].forEach((p)=>Object.keys(localStorage).filter((k)=>k===p||k.startsWith(p+'.')).forEach((k)=>localStorage.removeItem(k)));location.reload()
```

```
ctx.get('sessions')                              → 活会话：flush（驻留对象在无代理持有时再驱逐）
ctx.get('storageDomain') → 'session_projcache'   → 投影缓存行（域 + 文件双层）
ctx.get('storageDomain') → 'workspace'           → 工作区记账 + 归档/置顶集合（域 + 文件双层）
$DSH_HOME/sessions/<projectKey>/<id>/            → 磁盘日志目录

- 顺序：先删日志并验证删净，再清记账（半删会话不会掉出分组）；清理后逐层事后验证，未净显式报错，可直接重试；
- 工作区记录另走 harness 的 `workspaceRegistry.delete()`（pendingMutation 协议，进程在删除过程中退出也能在下次启动收尾）；无该服务时降级路径写同样的标记，记录删除失败会回滚 order；
- 护栏：会话 id 须匹配 `session-<uuid>`（或裸 uuid，不区分大小写）；**运行中拒绝（409）**；级联深度上限 `MAX_CASCADE_DEPTH = 8`，超出以 `cascadeTruncated: true` 显式报告；仅驻留不拒绝（先 `flush` 再清盘）；路径必须落在预期根内；**符号链接一律拒删**；全走 Node `fs`，不经 shell；
- TEMP 清扫按**内容归因**（目录内容提及会话 id 才删），受文件数/字节预算约束（超限报 `budgetHit`）；整棵级联只扫一次，各会话 `tempSweep[].dirs` 之和可能大于实际删除数（客户端摘要用去重合计 `tempSweepTotal`）。

逐帧解压 → 替换 → 逐帧重压缩，帧数与行结构不变；写回前落备份、写回后完整校验（内容一致 + 敏感值绝迹 + 帧数一致），失败自动回滚；**成功即删备份**。备份清理失败不回滚（避免把脱敏结果还原成明文），报告 `backupResidual`/`backupError`；单文件失败不中断其余文件。

- `secrets`：完整值（6–512 字符，至多 64 项）→ 掩码 `[REDACTED:xxxx…lenNN]`（保留前 4 位与总长）；6–8 位短值会泄露大半，建议改用 `prefixes` 或直接轮换；
- `prefixes`：已知前缀（4–32 位 `[A-Za-z0-9_-]`，至多 64 项），保留前缀、清除其后连续的字母/数字/`_`/`-`；
- 仅"运行中"拒绝（409）；请勿对**当前正查看**的会话执行（界面状态未验证）；
- 需 Node ≥ 23.8 的 zstd API（运行时检测；不满足时该路由 501，其余功能不受影响）。

```
dsh-session-purge/
├── package.json          # 包清单：dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client 声明
├── cordis.patch.yml      # bundle 层：向 profile 插入插件行
├── lib/index.js          # 宿主半：删除/脱敏管线 + 三个同源 HTTP 路由

信任模型与宿主 `api-request-trust` 一致：授权主体必须为 loopback；`sec-fetch-site: cross-site` 一律拒绝；`Origin` 存在时必须等于该主体（桌面端经 `dsh-app://` 转发会剥离 Origin，故缺失即放行）。
克隆或下载本仓库（无 npm 依赖），然后**二选一**：把 `dsh-session-purge` 放入 profile 的 bundles 列表，或在目标 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中 `insert` 一行 `name: 'dsh-session-purge'`。二者都做会加载两次。桌面版实测无需重启（`dsh-hmr` 热加载插件行）。

```powershell
node --test test/purge.test.mjs
```

当前 **36/36**（Node 24.21；无 zstd 的运行时跳过脱敏用例）。

- **无回收站**；不回收 `attachments` 引用计数；
- TEMP 清扫是内容归因：从未提及会话 id 的输出会留存；
- **删除当前正查看的会话宿主不拦**（无窗口守卫），其后界面表现未经端到端验证；
- 子代理不在面板列出（清理依赖主会话级联）；对话页的子代理家族条目是父日志的派生投影，删除后界面残留到重建（磁盘与记账已净）；孤儿子代理需手工清理；
- 驻留会话删除后：宿主仍持代理对象则保守跳过，幽灵行留到下次重启；
- Electron 渲染缓存可能短期保留已渲染内容（推断，未端到端验证）；
- 端到端验证：0.2.0-rc.2 真机验证三个路由与两个入口；0.2.1-rc.3 起为逐触点静态审计（2026-10-26，未重复端到端）；脱敏路由与"运行中拒绝"等守卫尚未在真实数据上触发过。

变更历史见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)（自 0.3.4 起记录）。

English | [简体中文](README.md)

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Community third-party plugin, not affiliated with DeepSeek. All touchpoints are internal Harness implementation surfaces (undocumented API).
> Compatibility baseline: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop` **0.2.1-rc.5** (Windows x64, nightly channel; rc.3 touchpoint audit 2026-10-26, rc.5 re-check 2026-10-30). Nightly updates may **break compatibility silently** — after upgrading DSH, run `node --test test/purge.test.mjs` (expect 36/36).

> [!WARNING]
> **Deletion is permanent; there is no recycle bin.** Redaction only rewrites local log files and is **not a substitute for key rotation**.

Two operations for DeepSeek Harness session data:

- **Permanent delete**: on-disk logs + projection cache + workspace accounting + tool-output temp files, cascading to all subagent sessions;
- **In-place redaction**: masks secret values (full value / prefix) inside the session's zstd log, preserving history and the frame structure.

| Entry | Location |
|---|---|
| Settings → **Session cleanup** | Session list grouped by workspace: single-session delete (inline two-step confirm, Enter/Esc/10 s auto-disarm), redaction dialog, "Delete workspace" (group-header button, two-step confirm; any member running → 409 for the whole request; partial failure keeps the workspace and reports `failures[]`), search and "disk residue only" filter |
| Session row "…" menu | "Delete" item at the end (official slot `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item`); deletes the session without switching the current conversation |
The completion dialog reports freed bytes, cascade counts and the temp-sweep summary; all dialog colors come from host theme tokens and follow light/dark themes.

Clears the layout whitelist only (prefix matching covers per-session keys); keybindings, drafts, terminal and schedules untouched. Alternatives: wider `localStorage.clear()`; stricter (exact boundaries + legacy boot-flag key):

```js
['dsh.sidebar-right.v1','dsh.sidebar-browser.v1','dsh.workspace.view.v5','dsh.conversation.contentWidth','dsh.trajectory.duration','dsh.trajectory.jsonStringWrapping','dsh.session-purge.reset-layout-on-boot'].forEach((p)=>Object.keys(localStorage).filter((k)=>k===p||k.startsWith(p+'.')).forEach((k)=>localStorage.removeItem(k)));location.reload()
```

```
ctx.get('sessions')                              → live session: flush (resident object evicted when no proxy holds it)
ctx.get('storageDomain') → 'session_projcache'   → projection cache rows (domain + file, two layers)
ctx.get('storageDomain') → 'workspace'           → workspace accounting + archived/pinned sets (domain + file, two layers)
$DSH_HOME/sessions/<projectKey>/<id>/            → on-disk log directory

Frame-by-frame decompress → replace → recompress; frame count and line structure preserved. Backup before write-back, full re-read verification after (content identical + secrets absent + frame count identical); failure rolls back automatically; **the backup is deleted immediately on success**. A failed backup cleanup does not roll back (that would restore plaintext); it reports `backupResidual`/`backupError`. One file failing never interrupts the others.

```
dsh-session-purge/
├── package.json          # manifest: dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client declarations
├── cordis.patch.yml      # bundle layer: inserts the plugin row into a profile
├── lib/index.js          # host half: delete/redact pipelines + three same-origin HTTP routes

Trust model identical to the host's `api-request-trust`: principal must be loopback; `sec-fetch-site: cross-site` always refused; when `Origin` is present it must equal the principal (the desktop client forwards via `dsh-app://`, which strips `Origin`, hence missing-Origin passes).

Clone or download this repository (no npm dependencies), then **choose exactly one**: add `dsh-session-purge` to the profile's bundles list, or `insert` a row `name: 'dsh-session-purge'` into the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. Doing both loads the plugin twice. On desktop no restart is needed (the `dsh-hmr` hot-loads the plugin row).

```powershell
node --test test/purge.test.mjs
```

Currently **36/36** (Node 24.21; runtimes without zstd skip the redaction cases).
Change history: [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) (from 0.3.4).
